calendarFaqs.q: What does “conference release” mean in District 279?
calendarFaqs.a: It means students do not attend school that day because conferences are scheduled. Families should check the separate elementary or secondary conference calendar for school and appointment details.

calendarFaqs.q: How does Osseo’s elementary six-day calendar work?
calendarFaqs.a: It is a numbered rotation used to align elementary physical education and music specialist schedules. It supplements the K–12 calendar and does not mean students attend six days per week.

As of August 12, 2026, the district’s calendar page lists the 2027–28 English K–12 calendar but does not yet list translated 2027–28 editions. Check the official Osseo calendars page for newly published translations.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Osseo Area Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for grades K–12 is Tuesday, September 7, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Osseo Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22–31, 2027. Students return Monday, January 3, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Osseo Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 27–31, 2028. March 31 is also identified as a district-closed holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: Are January 28 and April 14 no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: They are asynchronous remote-learning days, not holidays. Students work remotely while licensed staff complete instructional planning.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student contact days are in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar lists 172 contact days: 58 in trimester one, 58 in trimester two, and 56 in trimester three.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Osseo schools in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, June 8, 2028. Mark reporting follows June 9, and high-school commencement is June 11.
